ways.label: From Whakapapa Village to Silica Rapids
ways.time: 2 hr 30 min return from Whakapapa Village
evidence: After crossing Whakapapanui Stream at the top end of the Whakapapa Holiday Park, the track meanders through beech forest.
It starts 250 m above the Tongariro National Park Visitor Centre.
A little further up the hill the stream bed widens and forms a series of shallow terraces coated in creamy white deposits – the famous Silica Rapids.

ways.label: From Bruce Road car park to Silica Rapids
ways.time: 1 hr 30 min return from Bruce Road car park
ways.distance: 3 km return from Bruce Road car park
evidence: Heading towards the rapids, the track climbs onto a tussock-covered lava flow.
Head back to your vehicle the way you came.

doubts: The village start is given as the place Whakapapa Village (T7); the exact trailhead is '250 m above the Tongariro National Park Visitor Centre' and may be the road end F1 (Upper Whakapapanui Track at SH48), but the text does not name the track so I did not pick a road end. The Bruce Road section does not say exactly where it joins the village route.
